overrides.task: Plan candidate semantic mappings of four FW5 notions (active route, contrast contract, elimination without a truth machine, critical episode) onto the pilot harness's own records (pilot-offline-episode.txt fields and task-inputs.json record structure), declaring question/respect, boundary, grain, role bindings, obligations, contrasts before outcomes; decide which mappings warrant exploration.

Map 'active route' (FW5 L601) onto the episode's spawn->assemble chain. Candidate: events a0003 spawn -> a0004 assemble -> a0005 verify plus assembly.source_refs=['c0001'] and dependencies.c0001 constitute the connected subnetwork from named input 'SEALED_TASK' to operative result artifact sha256:e4892dae...; role bindings are the template_id='direct_answer' child and 'accepted' status. Attack: L601 requires connection to the named represented input and nonconstant dependence on the relevant represented distinction under declared contrasts. Episode shows a single run of arithmetic with no contrast variation and no represented input port distinct from the constant '6 times 7', so dependence is not exhibited. Missing definition: which record field carries the 'named represented input' and its port-to-port connections. Discriminating outcome: if a second run existed varying one operand, dependence would be exhibited. Preserve candidate; reverse if a contrast run is recorded.

Map 'contrast contract' (FW5 L123, L140) onto the episode. Candidate: the sealed task text 'What is 6 times 7? Return the integer as plain text.' and the JSON keys task/answer encode the question contract (respect=plain-integer answer), while the event list seal/route/spawn/assemble/verify and child.outputs are the scope Sigma with baseline (1,b0)=a0001 SEALED_TASK. Attack: L123 says the contrast contract includes the baseline and is not identified with a collection of performed experiments, and L630 requires a content-changing case, a content-preserving recoding, and the objection-vs-carrier distinction. Episode omissions state 'No ... recoding intervention' and the child output has empty source_refs/unresolved/verification_refs; no alternative edit or recoding is recorded. So the performed-event list is exactly 'a collection of performed experiments' and is not the contrast contract. Missing definition: which record field, if any, is the input-change/component-change specification. Discriminating outcome: a recorded alternative operand or answer-string variant would realize the content-changing case. Preserve candidate and its rejection; reverse if such a variant appears.

Map 'elimination without a truth machine' (FW5 L661, L663-L676, L630) onto verify events. Candidate: a0005 choice='verify' with terminal.verification_status='verified' and verification_scope='The answer is the decimal representation of 6 times 7.' is a machine check establishing equality with the SOURCE claim, matching L661's allowed 'equality with source bytes' proposition. Attack: L669-L676 formula T and B and I implies O; established not-O yields not-(T and B and I), not not-T without premises about B and I. Episode records only a passing execution; assembly.verification_refs=[] and child.verification_refs=[] are empty, so the verification artifact ref required to test B and I is absent. Also no machine check eliminates any competing explanation — the child is template_id='direct_answer' with source_refs=[], so nothing distinguishes arithmetic-from-representation from a lookup. Missing definition: no O, B, or I field is exposed. Discriminating outcome: a recorded falsifying run or auxiliary/interpretation field would let K3 apply. Preserve: the 'verified' label is a limited equality proposition, not elimination of alternatives; reverse if a doc-level check with auxiliaries is produced.

Map 'critical episode' (FW5 L773, L777, L609, L628, L630, L634) onto the episode. Candidate: task asks 'What is 6 times 7?' and the surrounding pilot run is the recognized difficulty; a represented target exists (a0001 sealed task + child organization); resolve via assemble/verify closes the episode; refused/a0001-a0005 is a complete engagement. Attack: L773 requires a recognized difficulty, a represented target available BEFORE the criticism, a conjectural objection, and a content-sensitive response with a resulting situation. The episode omissions explicitly state: 'No live hidden organization, no critical objection/return/use episode'. child.output.unresolved=[] and no objection field exists; L609 requires represented target z, alleged defect delta, grounds g, and a proposed g->delta connection — none is a record field. L630 requires a content-changing case plus recoding plus carrier distinction; none present. L634: lacking data makes attribution unresolved, not proven understanding or absence. Missing: no objection/grounds/defect schema. Discriminating outcome: a recorded objection with its grounds and a response that changes under a grounds edit would establish the episode is critical. Preserve the 'complete engagement is NOT a critical episode' correction; reverse if an objection record appears.

Type-tag the four mappings by failure kind, per the task's four-way distinction. (a) source-clause challenge: is any FW5 clause itself contested by the record? Candidate: L1052 'decorative transcript channel permanently disconnected from the operative state does not satisfy the condition' is not contested because the episode has no decorated channel. (b) missing application criterion: which field in pilot-offline-episode.txt encodes 'named represented input port', 'input-change specification', 'auxiliaries B', or 'objection grounds g'? None is present. (c) unsupported mapping: the 'active route' and 'critical episode' candidates assert structure not denoted by any field — classify unsupported, not merely unresolved. (d) instrument failure: distinct from all of the above; no tool failure occurred within this plan since source_reads is only a receipt and no read was attempted unread. Discriminating outcome: an actual read_source receipt with a pinned unit and byte range that returns a field would move a mapping from (b/c) toward support. Missing definition: no enumerated field schema for objections/B/I/z/delta/g is exposed.

Synthesize the human-inspectable map/attack/revision table. Rows: (1) active route -> corrected to 'unsupported mapping: connected subnetwork asserted but no contrast-dependent dependence and no named represented input field'; (2) contrast contract -> corrected to 'missing application criterion + unsupported mapping: performed-event list is not the contrast contract per L123'; (3) elimination without truth machine -> corrected to 'limited machine check per L661; elimination NOT established because B and I fields absent (L676)'; (4) critical episode -> corrected to 'missing application criterion: complete engagement is not a critical episode; L609/630 schema unrepresented'. Preserve all rejected versions (the original optimistic mappings) verbatim in the table. Name reversal evidence per row. Note: conclusions are conditional on pinned excerpts only; unread portions never inferred (decisive_question constraint).

Produce the actionable next investigation and provisional continuation log. Proposed next investigation (NOT executed here, never claimed as run): one targeted P-A2 read_source of the pinned FW5 excerpts unit over the byte range containing L1052 and L1364-L1372 (already in pinned excerpts, so no new source needed) to test whether return-relevance and refutation criteria supply the missing application criteria; a second proposed intervention is a recorded recoding/variant run in the harness. Continuation log PROVISIONAL self-check (per decisive_question): decision pre-host is CONTINUE with reason 'mappings corrected but reversal evidence (contrast run, objection record, B/I fields) not yet sought'; remaining calls and estimated dollars are host-delivered and not asserted here; authoritative CONTINUE/STOP belongs to the pilot continue_or_stop control call after actual verification, and no such call or verification ref is claimed to have occurred. Unresolved commitments: application criteria for L601/L609/L123/L676; reversal evidence per row. Intended next route: one read_source pass over pinned bytes only.
